claim: AC-2 SCRHUN loads the DSCORE score area and adds the thousands/hundreds digit — the routine that 'INCREMENTs SCORE BY THOUSANDS AND HUNDREDS' (JOUSTRV4.SRC:7340), the digit packing thousands in the high nibble, hundreds in the low ($15->1500, $10->1000) (JOUSTRV4.SRC:7346).

source.verbatim: SCRHUN	LDY	DSCORE,X	GET SCORE AREA

claim: AC-2 SCRTEN loads the DSCORE score area and adds the BACKWARDS tens/hundreds digit — the routine whose input digit is 'TENS & HUNDREDS BCD DIGIT (BACKWARDS)' (JOUSTRV4.SRC:7353), tens in the high nibble, hundreds in the low ($57->750, not 570) (JOUSTRV4.SRC:7357).

source.verbatim: SCRTEN	LDY	DSCORE,X	GET SCORE AREA

claim: AC-2 SCRTEN masks the HIGH nibble (ANDA #$F0) as the SCORE TENS — the backwards packing puts the tens place in the high nibble (JOUSTRV4.SRC:7360).
AC-2 SCRTEN masks the LOW nibble (ANDB #$0F) as the hundreds — the backwards packing puts the hundreds place in the low nibble, so $57 = 5 tens + 7 hundreds = 750 (JOUSTRV4.SRC:7361).
